title: alstonia lenormandii var. lanceolifera
intro: Alstonia lenormandii var. lanceolifera, commonly known as Chinese Thunder of God Vine, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alstonia lenormandii var. lanceolifera include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
